lead.headline: QM SURGES TO #1 ON GITHUB
lead.deck: YC-Software's QM repository is rapidly gaining traction as the fastest-growing project on GitHub, with a staggering 2,428 new stars in the last day alone, bringing its total to 7,716
lead.body: This sudden surge in popularity can be attributed to the project's innovative approach to facilitating multiplayer agent interactions, which is poised to revolutionize the way teams collaborate and work together. The open-source repository, which has been rapidly gaining momentum, promises to streamline workflows and enhance productivity by providing a versatile and customizable framework for harnessing the power of multiple agents. As a result, developers and industry professionals alike are taking notice, contributing to the project's exponential growth and cementing its status as a leader in the field of collaborative software development
